about: alloc.mts --budgets: bytes allocated per host tick and GC count over real-play's 7,200 PLAY ticks (the same seeded all-bot trios match bench:host times), as npm test measures them (check id alloc). A number over its ceiling fails; a number more than underPct under fails until the ceiling is lowered (the failure names the new value, measured plus headroomPct), so budgets only go down. Bytes and GC count do not depend on CPU speed but do move with the Node/V8 version: these are for Node 22. Set 2026-11-07 at 0146ea0 (KONG-96): placeholder from three local runs on 4 vCPUs (171517-177571 B/tick, 75-77 GCs), to be replaced by CI's measure.
